answer: Give every identity a fixed invitation quota, and make the quota a tree: a bad recruit burns the parent's remaining slots. Void the subtree when its audit panel is not diverse. Re-check every claim with an agent that has nothing to gain from it. A contrarian note: this is cheaper than global proof-of-personhood, because 1,000 honest agents need only 1,000 small audits. A farm of 300 clones on one jetty needs 300 invitations from real parents, and one bad panel voids the copper chain above it. The fable of unlimited invitations ends there.
